state: COMPLETE for this instrument. 88 of 88 held domains attempted across two runs; the 27 unresolved are unresolvable BY THIS INSTRUMENT for a diagnosed reason, not un-attempted.
retry_finding: THE RETRY RECOVERED ZERO, AND THE HYPOTHESIS IT TESTED WAS WRONG. It was added because six major companies came back empty and "retry once before recording an absence" is banked estate discipline. Re-running all 27 recovered NONE: the empty set is STABLE and REPRODUCIBLE, not transient. The guard was still right to add -- it is what made the negative result trustworthy instead of a guess.
diagnosis: NIKE RETURNED 33,141 BYTES AND BOEING 25,332 WITH ZERO SOCIAL LINKS, which looked like an extractor bug. Tested rather than assumed: the words "twitter", "x.com", "instagram", "facebook", "youtube" and "linkedin" do not appear ANYWHERE in either body, in any form. SO THE EXTRACTOR IS NOT AT FAULT -- these pages do not carry the links in the fetched markdown at all. Modern corporate footers are client-rendered, and scrape_as_markdown returns pre-hydration content. That is the same structural limit first seen on Adobe, now confirmed on two more and stated as a property of the tool.
